messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 502/504 error rate on api-gateway-prod (service: api-gateway, route: /v1/*). Alert: failure_rate=72% over 10m, p50 latency 240ms, p95 2.1s. On-call: @dave (oncall) paged. Alert link: https://monitoring.redwood/api/alerts/1756001357

n dave (oncall): On it. Reproducing now, joining voice. Which region?

alice: seeing spikes across r-aws-us-east and r-aws-eu-west. Edge frontends returning 502s, looks like upstream 5xx from gateway pods. No infra deploys in last 30m from deploy-bot.

carol: logs show `502 route_fail` with `ERR: upstream reset` from gateway->backend pool after connection timeout. Quick grep: `grep -i \"upstream reset\" /var/log/gateway/*.log | tail -n 50` shows a pattern starting ~10:12 UTC.

bob: autoscaling didn't key in yet; upstream pool cpu at 88% but not OOM. Could be connection saturation (too many keepalive sockets).

alice: any recent config changes? I see a canary routing change at 10:05 pushed to envoy config for header-based routing: `x-experiment: v2`.

sre-lead: Tagging this P1. Primary hypothesis: new header-based route (canary) is overloading a smaller backend pool, causing connection resets. Short-term mitigation: disable canary routing and shift traffic away from the small pool.

dave (oncall): I'm going to flip the canary routing off (envoy) and scale the backend pool. Executing now.

# command
carol: Run (internal command):
```
# disable canary route
kubectl -n prod exec deploy/envoy-control -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/config/update -d '{"routes": {"/v1/": {"header_match": null}}}'
# scale backend
kubectl -n prod scale deployment backend-pool-sm --replicas=8
```

dave (oncall): Disabled header-rule and scaled backend-pool-sm from 2 -> 8. Watching errors.

monitoring-bot: Alert update: failure_rate dropped to 43% (5m) after config change. p95 latency down to 1.1s. Still elevated.

support-agent: Support: We're seeing ~120 customer-facing errors in last 10m, top customers: cust-omega (10 errors), cust-sparrow (7 errors). Posting a short status page update: `Investigating elevated API errors impacting some requests to /v1/; mitigation in progress.`

carol: Found stacktrace in backend logs: `http_client.go:401: dial tcp: lookup upstream-service: connection refused` starting at 10:11:45. Looks like upstream-service instances flapped.

bob: I suspect a healthcheck mismatch. The new canary route was nailed to a set that had different readiness probe. That would make envoy still send traffic to pods not yet ready. Rolling traffic to healthy pool is correct interim.

sre-lead: Agreed. Next step: adjust envoy weights to move 95% traffic to backend-pool-lg. Also enable short-term circuit-breaker at gateway: max_connections=1000 -> 400 to avoid head-of-line failures.

# suggested commands
alice: Run these (I have them staged):
```
# shift weight
curl -X POST https://control-plane.prod/api/routes/weights -d '{"route":"/v1/","weights":{"backend-pool-lg":0.95,"backend-pool-sm":0.05}}'
# tighten circuit-breaker
kubectl -n prod patch configmap/gateway-cb --patch '{"data":{"max_connections":"400"}}'
```

dave (oncall): Applied weights and circuit-breaker patch. Confirming connections dropped and errors continue to decline.

monitoring-bot: Metrics: failure_rate=19% (2m) p95=0.45s. Count of 502/504s trending down.

support-agent: Updated status: `Mitigations applied; partial recovery under way. SDK calls may see intermittent 502s for the next ~30m.` Added note to customers with active incidents.

carol: While scaling and weight shift helped, there's a latent issue: upstream-service logs show occasional `accept: too many open files`. Need to check ulimit and file descriptor usage on that fleet.

bob: On it — bumping ulimit on the next rollout and scheduling a hotfix for the readiness probe behavior. I'm also going to add ephemeral connection pool increase on the larger pool to absorb retries.

sre-lead: Good. For the next 15m we keep traffic off the canary. No rollback required for code, this is config + infra. Prepare a short post-incident timeline when stabilized.

dave (oncall): Current status: routing config changed, backend scaled, circuit-breaker tightened. System trending healthy. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then hand off to morning SRE at 06:00 local.

monitoring-bot: Final update in this window: failure_rate=4% (1m), p95=0.22s. Alarm cleared.

support-agent: Notifying affected customers with a follow-up that we mitigated the issue; ticket auto-created CHG-1756001357 for outreach.

alice: Logging remediation commands for postmortem. Please collect envoy configs, backend readiness probe history, and FD counts from the upstream fleet.

sre-lead: Assigning postmortem: owners: @bob, @carol. Timeline owner: @alice. Draft due EOD tomorrow.

dave (oncall): Handoff: I'll leave the channel open for 30m watch; otherwise moving to follow-up thread for postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P1 status changed -> "mitigated". Links: runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/runbooks/gateway-502, postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/pm/1756001357-draft
